'''Polish Duel Championship Series''' is a Quakeworld duel league intended exclusively for players from [[Poland]].

In [[2021]], during the ongoing Covid pandemic, many Polish Quakeworld players started playing again. Therefore, an idea was born to organize a league for them. Over the following seasons, the number of active Polish players and those interested in participating in the league increased. From Season 3, divisions were introduced to limit the number of matches and organize players according to their skills.

The league's goal is to provide fun and pleasure in playing our beloved game. That's why there are no monetary prizes. The only reward is FAME, GLORY and SATISFACTION.
